patterns.note: Full-bleed, immersive video/image sections dominate the scroll experience, each presenting a distinct visual and thematic statement.
Large, uppercase, single-word headings are used to introduce new thematic sections, creating a bold, editorial feel.
A high-contrast palette of black and white is used for text and UI elements, allowing the rich, often desaturated, background imagery to take prominence.
The hero features a subtle parallax effect on the product and background, transitioning into full-screen, scroll-triggered section reveals with large, animating text overlays.
Each major content block is presented as a full-viewport section with a distinct background video/image and a prominent, single-word heading.

technique_notes: Implement a full-bleed hero section with a video background that subtly parallaxes as the user scrolls, while a key product element (the watch) also moves with a slight offset.
Create a secondary navigation bar that initially sits below the hero, then becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after a certain scroll threshold.

Design subsequent content sections as full-viewport height containers, each with its own background video or image. Use scroll-triggered animations to reveal large, uppercase text overlays as each section scrolls into view, creating a dramatic, sequential narrative, leveraging video-hero technology for backgrounds.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase headings (~4-5x body) create strong visual impact, while body text is small and functional.
design_tokens.spacing: airy hero and section breaks, with balanced spacing in footer elements.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its cinematic, full-bleed video backgrounds that serve as immersive section dividers, paired with large, single-word headings that create a powerful, editorial narrative. The prominent, almost sculptural display of the product in the hero section, combined with subtle parallax, sets a luxurious and high-quality tone.
